summary: Iter 216n - Logo upload, GET /organization/logo, public files serving, invoice parsing, and master admin user creation: All 9 backend tests PASSED after fixing a bug in GET /organization/logo endpoint.
seed_data_creation: Test org and user created during pytest run with TEST_ prefix
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 216n features fully tested. Key findings: (1) POST /api/organization/logo correctly creates files collection entry with category='branding' and is_public=true, returns logo_url starting with /api/public/files/{id}, and updates both organizations.logo_url AND organizations.branding.logo_url. (2) Fixed bug in GET /organization/logo where it was returning None because the endpoint tried to look up by storage_path when the logo_url was already in /api/public/files/{id} format. Added check for /api/public/files/ prefix to return directly. (3) GET /api/public/files/{file_id} correctly serves binary image with Content-Type: image/png. (4) Invoice parsing endpoints (parse-invoice and parse-for-wizard) both work under 60s with Carshalton PDF, returning supplier_name='Pulse Fitness' and equipment items with valid make and equipment_category. (5) Master admin add user with role=master_admin correctly sets is_master_admin=true on the user doc.

bug_fixed.issue: GET /organization/logo was returning None when logo_url was in /api/public/files/{id} format because it tried to look up by storage_path instead of recognizing the canonical URL format
bug_fixed.fix: Added check: if logo_path.startswith('/api/public/files/'), return it directly without database lookup

invoice_parsing_verification.equipment_category: All items have valid category (Cardiovascular, Strength, etc.)
